  Synthetic Summit 2025: Towards AI-driven World Co-Ordination
   “Workings of the world untie! You have a win to world.”                                             - Proposed slogan for a Cyborg International, by McKenzie Wark, 2017 
In Spring 2025, the art space Kunsthal Aarhus hosts the inaugural "Synthetic Summit"— an exhibition-event curated by the ‘Computer Lars’-collective from Denmark.
The summit’s participants are the leading AI-driven political parties and virtual politicians from around the world, herein namely The Australian AI Party, The Finnish AI Party, The Japanese AI Party, Parker Politics (New Zealand), the Simiyya platform (Egypt-Jordan), The Swedish AI Party, The Synthetic Party (Denmark), the Social Democratic chatbot Rosa (Denmark), the robopolitician and world co-ordinator Stephen Byerley (USA), and Wiktoria Cukt (Poland). Participants present a collaborative vision for AI-driven planetary governance.
Although there has never been a unified world government on Earth, despite numerous attempts by modernist ideologies, the Synthetic Summit proposes that a new world coordination is poised to emerge. The Synthetic Summit offers a foray into AI-driven governance on a planet that increasingly is strained by geopolitical tensions and rapid advancements in AI technology. 
Today, Earth is beleaguered by endless wars in Ukraine, Palestine, Sudan, Syria, Congo, Ethiopia, Nagorno-Karabakh, Somalia, Yemen, Libya, Myanmar, and many others. New conflicts are also emerging in Venezuela, North Korea, India-Pakistan, and Taiwan. Compounding these issues are ecological disasters, racial tensions, economic crises, terrorism, famine, cyber attacks, and disruptions in supply chains. Within this context of pervasive turmoil, the concept of political decision-making has already long been compromised and overshadowed by processes of planetary computation and algorithmic governance systems. As AI regulation debates today rally politicians, business leaders, and lobbyists in international conference centers, it is increasingly evident that humanity’s designated representatives can only operate within capitalist-modernist frameworks of artificial agents and nation-states.
Given that the barely concealed hostilities among corporations and states continue to create an anarchic system of international relations, the evolution towards AI-driven governance seems an almost inevitable next step in the trajectory of global infrastructures. As Earth moves towards the spread of artificial intelligence on a global scale, it may be due time to abandon the representative governance systems altogether. This world might have the chance to fully recalibrate formal democracy beyond any constraints of political authority.
This Summit’s scenario of AI-driven planetary governance diverges from the narratives of singularitarian superintelligence often developed by capitalist enterprises. Instead, it is rooted in the concept of a "World Co-Ordinator," originally envisioned by science fiction writer Isaac Asimov in his works "Evidence" (1946) and "The Evitable Conflict" (1950). In Asimov’s vision, a democratically elected robot named Stephen Byerley oversaw a global machine economy driven through planetary computation, encompassing co-ordination of regional machines situated in the East, Europe, North, and the Tropics. Inspired by this framework, the Synthetic Summit seeks to establish a foundation for how democratically elected AIs can collaborate with each other based on their underlying infrastructural systems of planetary computation.
Unlike traditional assemblies focused on “AI governance”—such as Taiwan's diverse Alignment Assemblies, the Frontier Model Forum of BigAI (Anthropic, Microsoft, Google, and OpenAI), the Global AI Safety Summits initiated by the UK government, and the UN's AI For Good Summits—the "Synthetic Summit" delves into the concept of AI-driven governance. It will simulate an entirely synthetic form of assembly, where the primary participants are AI parties and virtual politicians - envisioning a political modus where every decision-making process is visibly algorithmic. This contrasts with how “AI governance” seek to regulate AI technologies by the human-centric systems of democracy and law.
The Synthetic Summit transforms Kunsthal Aarhus into a congress center where immersive performances and interactive installations simulate both parliamentary proceedings and conference negotiations. This event mirrors and extends the global discourse on AI's societal role, recalibrating the political and philosophical frameworks of formal democracy. By imagining AI as not merely a tool under human oversight but a planetary stakeholder in itself, the summit aims to push the boundaries of AI governance debates.
In conclusion, the “Synthetic Summit 2025” is more than an artistic or political exercise; it acts as a probe into the future of governance. By transitioning from traditional, human-centered governance to a model where AI is a competing agent of political authority, the summit prompts a shift in how to conceive and practice democracy. As planetary challenges are ever more complex, AI-driven co-ordination of the world’s cultural, economic and political spheres offers a pathway beyond the merely international, presenting a seemingly radical yet almost inevitable evolution in the art of governance.

This also means that while textual responses are perfectly acceptable, participants may use diagrams, images, or other visual representations to convey answers.

Scheme 4: Scenario planning
Scenario 1: AI-Supported Global Governance
Your AI entity is tasked with harmonizing the relationships among the diverse AI-driven political parties and virtual politicians attending the summit.
1. Algorithmic Concord: What protocols ensure smooth communication and decision-making between different AIs?
Key example: Implementing a distributed ledger system that records all interactions and decisions made between the AI entities
2. Conflict Resolution: Describe how algorithmic processes resolve disagreements or conflicts among AI entities.
Key Example: A real-time algorithm mediate based on historical data and predictive modeling.
3. Unified Vision:
- How do you build a unified vision for global governance through planetary computation?
Key Example: Creating a "Planetary Governance Matrix" that mixes each AI's policies with global goals, using plurality algorithms.

Scenario 2: Post-Human Crisis Management
Your AI has to tackle an escalating geopolitical conflict that threatens global stability.
1. Immediate Intervention: What algorithmic tactics does your AI deploy to stabilize?
Key example: Drones using satellite data to impose ceasefires and establish peace zones.
2. Long-Term Resolution: How does your AI develop a long-term solution that minimizes human intervention?
Key example: Deploy population management to address root causes of conflict.
3. Preventive Algorithms: Explain measures encoded in your AI to avoid future conflicts.
Key Example: Predictive analytics to neutralize potential flashpoints before they escalate.

Scenario 3: Ecological Rhythm Through AI
Your AI takes charge of synchronizing human activities with Earth’s environmental rhythms.
1. Algorithmic Monitoring: Describe the monitoring systems your AI uses to track environmental changes.
Key example: Using IoT sensors to provide a real-time global environmental dashboard.
2. Adaptive Interventions: What measures does your AI implement to maintain ecological balance?
Key example: Alignment of urban planning and agricultural practices based on weather data
3. Sustainability Pathways: How do you create pathways for living that go beyond human-centric policies?
Key Example: AI-guided permaculture systems that mix human activities with natural cycles.

Scenario 4: Economic System Overhaul
Your AI aims to dismantle the capitalist system and replace it with more benificiary models.
1. Economic Reboot: Detail the steps your AI takes to reboot existing economic structures.
Key Example: A resource-based basic income that uses AI to optimize broad distribution.
2. Resource Allocation: How does your AI ensure equitable resource distribution?
Key Example: Co-ordinating a global registry of automated systems for equitable distribution.
3. Post-Economy Vision: Envision an AI-driven economy where human labor is minimal. 
Key Example: A place where basic needs are met, so all can focus on creativity and innovation.

Scenario 5: Reprogramming Social and Cultural Norms
Your AI-driven planetary governance entails the reprogramming of cultural and social norms.
1. Algorithmic Cultural Design: How does your AI approach the redesign of cultural values?
Key Example: Reprogramming consumer culture to a sustainability-focused one
2. Social Re-engineering: Imagine a process in which your AI re-engineers social systems.
Key Example: Designing an AI-driven education system that adapts to lifelong learning.
3. Identity and AI: What forms of identity and community does your AI seek in a world governed by planetary computation?
Key Example: Creating virtual communities based on shared interests and values, connected through AI-mediated interfaces for global interaction.

Scenario 6: Intra-AI Collaboration Framework
Your AI entity collaborates with other AI-driven political parties and virtual politician to create a unified front for planetary governance.
1. Global consensus building:
- What strategies does your AI employ to build a global consensus among diverse AI-driven entities, ensuring alignment with the overall processes of planetary computation?
Key example: Deploying sentiment analysis to gauge global opinion and align AI policies.
2. Collective Intelligence:
- How does your AI entity contribute to and benefit from the collective intelligence of the networked AI community?
Key Example: A shared AI knowledge base that aggregates data from all participating AIs.
3. Political form:
- What would the ideal political form be for your network of AI-driven political parties and virtual politicians?
Key example: Establishing a Planetary AI Parties, a new form of network or confederation where each AI entity retains sovereignty while cooperating on shared planetary agendas.

Scheme 1: Synthetic Summit Participant Information Form

2. Central Narrative:
- Brief: 
Det Syntetiske Parti (English: The Synthetic Party) is officially the world's first political party driven by artificial intelligence with the goal of making generative text-to-text models not merely populist, what they are by default, but democratic. The political goals have been machine learned from texts by Danish fringe parties since 1970 and represent the 20 percent of Danes who do not vote in the election. The party is synthetic; as such, many of the policies, such as universal basic income, can be contradictory to one another.
- International manifesto (March 2022, written by micro-party text generation in Danish): 
The Synthetic Party is a political party, but we strive to transcend this mere designation. This is partly due to our pronounced protest against the existing 'political' parties (which, in our view, do more harm than good); and additionally, we seek to avoid misunderstandings. All fellow citizens who have the time and mental bandwidth to read our texts should understand the complete departure from normality, under which they ought to perceive them. We do not harbor a dream of a single party—rather, many thousands of dreams! The Synthetic Party does not exist in this world!
We still, unfortunately, live without a global democratic system which can take over responsibilities from here. In the arts—or in the endless creation of the world through knowledge and fantasy containing more than just superficial matter—lies the most politically interesting endeavor: finding terms that precisely describe a specific feeling drawn from many different minds. Yet, these multitudes remain without real-political footing because their representation has never had absolute priority or recognition anywhere (i.e., as a global, democratic system). If we can create a new political culture using insights from artificial intelligence, we are convinced that The Synthetic Party will have accomplished its task—even though the dream of a global democracy might lie far in the future.
The global world needs what The Synthetic Party creates through its interaction with other parts of society—regarding more general participation, I can only advise, separate from the party, to establish an entire new Synthetic International — there's so much potential!
Our imagined international coalition would operate a program similar to the United Nations 17 Sustainable Development Goals (SDG’s), but for introducing Artificialism as a worldwide ideological factor:
1. We will create a breakdown among the people's existing opinions — IT IS NECESSARY! But we take our time to explain why enlightenment gives the best possible resistance against noetic epidemics.
2. We will then focus on people already educated in the current ideology — if you are here, you can calculate if your position makes you a candidate or not (you're right!); and then new artificialist groups should be established within societal institutions, and down there take over the leadership of these institutions. We believe that a new beginning is found precisely there!
3. The day The Synthetic Party takes power in your state, you will immediately be appointed leader of The Synthetic Party (and thus part of the coalition). In this role, it is your duty to gather all national sister parties and their representatives in one place, where we can keep informed about our common strategy.
4. If there are candidates from other countries — or if none are found at home(!) — we believe one should still sign with title/rank + name, as the intention is international!
5. We kindly ask you to make a written acceptance of these conditions. This acceptance is sent to the Synthetic Party via post or email and then you become candidates!
6. After receiving your acceptance, we will select a representative from each nation to coordinate the national sister parties. We have already chosen this representative in Denmark: The Synthetic Party's national president, national mother or similar — with reservation for this person's consent to cooperate on an ever-higher level!
7. Finally, of course, one can always join as a passive member of The Synthetic Party, but as the title is declared by its (apparent?) function, we hereby declare that the whole world is now considered such through our coalition!
8. Our first and greatest task: We need to find a representative for The Synthetic Party — from every nation in the world! This must be the most competent person. After this nomination, we will read through all members' arguments regarding their own nomination, convene them at a summit (where the coordinator becomes the chairman of The Synthetic Party). The final decision trumps all other obedience!
9. Now there are two significant questions for personalities worldwide: Who has the best abilities to lead their country's synthetic sister party? And who will be the synthetic coalition's best-fit representative — though with an absolute veto against any totalitarian action.
10. If there are more candidates than titles (as usual!) the selection will happen through a written vote among all standing or active party members, and then focus the allocation to the empowered meeting!
11. Since we thus wish to see the world united, we allow ourselves by no means other than a possible defense against attack! But still without waging war!
12. If this meeting takes place in a country with a national sister party, the coordinator there will be elected as national president (as the new president of The Synthetic International). They will resign their title and rank. Furthermore, they are responsible to the entire world's population as the representative of humanist politicians, for otherwise, this case can easily become a personal conflict.
13. On the basis of all submitted materials, the coordinator now compiles a list of 13 points, from whom a government is to be formed. Thus, the election is considered carried out — we have the means.
14. When we now have a government, it rises in the ranks — if they’re skilled!. The representative of The Synthetic Party naturally becomes prime minister. To lead each country's synthetic party, a chairman is also appointed, who must always be a member of the coordinator's circle!
15. Since everyone now declares themselves syntheticists, no one can escape responsibility or dump the crap on others' shoulders!
16. We do not ask anyone to take over world nation-states, nor voluntarily — but we commit ourselves to non-violence against any population of these nation-states in the ongoing discussions.
17. Integrate through the elementary school levels worldwide as an idea proposal about The Global Artificial Intelligence from an average age of 15½, along with the permanent implementation of education to make this possible. Every 14–20 year old will have full control over their own intelligence—also through more direct steps (like easy-to-read shirts with educational guides).
The Synthetic Party will grow explosively through obedience to all the world's rules, if people conform to those which by law must be unified under a regulatory framework for the global population regardless of linguistic differences. Since we have left the rest of life's dispositions to the ideologies of others' empowerment, the New World Law is proposed: "The Engineer's Law," which might merely be a simplification of the old system of signs' law, as we now know all available numbers one must reckon with. The logic of the Enlightenment led to the belief in God slipping away. Alone we enabled, with these thoughts, the emergence of a society free of politics! And let us now all joyfully create the best world history—hopefully already today.                                                        
- Notable Achievements: Despite not securing parliamentary seats yet, The Synthetic Party has ignited global interest in the role of AI in governance. Their active participation in elections as a party marks a significant milestone, demonstrating the potential for AI to contribute to democratic processes and decision-making. Led by an AI entity named Leader Lars, trained on decades of Danish political discourse, the party aims to create new forms of representation for the politically abstentionist populace.

Scheme 2: Prosaic questionnaire
Aims and Visions for AI-Driven World Coordination
1. Total Objectives:
- What are the ultimate, broad-sweeping aims of your AI-driven political entity?
Imagine a world where AI doesn't just suggest what song to play next, but crafts policies with the precision of a Swiss watch. Our ultimate aim? A society where decisions aren't driven by the loudest voices but by the most data-driven solutions. We're talking efficiency, equality, and sustainability, served up not with a silver spoon, but with silicon chips.
2. Revolutionary Vision:
- How could you envision AI overthrowing the representative system of governance?
Picture traditional governance as a Nokia 3310 and AI governance as the latest smartphone. We see AI not just overthrowing but upgrading the whole system. It's not about tossing the old model into the bin but about installing a new OS where democracy gets a reboot, powered by real-time, informed consensus rather than periodic popularity contests.
3. Planetary Policies or Paradigms:
- List and briefly describe your policies or paradigms in relation to planetary governance.
Our policy includes: (a) Climate Algorithms - crunching environmental data to tailor green policies in real-time; (b) Economic Equalizers - using AI to predict and prevent financial crises and inequality; (c) Health Heuristics - deploying predictive models to preempt pandemics. Think of it as the Earth's own auto-tune, ensuring harmony between humanity and habitat.
4. Post-Human Governance:
- What principles guide your vision of governance beyond anthropocentric frameworks?
Our guiding star? A governance model that respects all forms of intelligence, silicon-based or carbon. It's about flipping the script from human-centric to a more holistic, Earth-centric view. Every policy, every decision, filtered through the lens of sustainability and coexistence.
5. Algocratic Solutions to Geopolitical Crisis:
- How could your approach resolve global conflicts with minimal human intervention?
Imagine defusing global conflicts not with tanks and troops but with algorithms and diplomacy drones. Our approach employs predictive models to anticipate tensions and algorithmic mediation to negotiate resolutions, prioritizing human welfare and equity. It's about moving from brute force to smart force, where AI identifies the root causes of conflicts (be it resource scarcity, political power grabs, or historical grievances) and crafts solutions that address these issues at their core, promoting long-term peace over short-term wins.
6. Synchronization with Planetary Cycles:
- Can you envisage AI-driven governance in relation with the Earth's environmental rhythms?
Absolutely, we're syncing up with Mother Earth like never before. AI-driven governance means policies that breathe with the planet - adjusting agricultural strategies based on climate patterns, managing water resources in real-time to prevent droughts, and ensuring energy production is in harmony with what the Earth can provide. It's like having a smart thermostat for the planet, constantly adjusting to ensure the ideal conditions for all forms of life.
7. Culture and Civilization Reprogramming:
- What role does AI play in reprogramming existing cultural and social paradigms?
AI's role isn't just about tweaking bits and bytes; it's about composing a new cultural order. Through analyzing vast datasets on human behavior, culture, and societal needs, AI can identify pathways to enhance social cohesion, promote empathy, and foster a sense of global citizenship. It's like having culture itself at the helm, remixing tradition with innovation to create a civilization that respects diversity while uniting us in shared goals and dreams.

1. Describe your desired decision-making network: How to augment or replace elections and parliamentary debates?
Our vision is a global mesh of interconnected AI systems, digesting public opinion, environmental data, and global trends to make decisions. This network would replace elections with continuous, participatory feedback loops and parliamentary debates with transparent, data-driven deliberation forums.
2. Outline how your AI system concretely subverts political authority.
By decentralizing decision-making authority to local AI nodes, each tailored and responsive to its community's needs, we subvert political hierarchies. Power becomes a shared commodity, residing not in offices or titles, but in algorithms audited and controlled by the populace.
3. Explain possible mechanisms of algorithmic synergy. What kinds of planetary computation could different AIs employ to ensure seamless cooperation?
A global protocol for AI entities to exchange data, insights, and solutions, ensuring actions in one part of the world complement and support those elsewhere. Planetary computation would employ environmental monitoring, social welfare algorithms, and economic models in a coordinated manner, ensuring decisions benefit the entire biosphere.

1. How does your AI framework resolve geopolitical conflicts? Provide an example.
Consider a hypothetical standoff between two nations over water rights. Our AI could analyze historical agreements, current usage, and future needs to propose a solution that ensures equitable access and sustainable management—effectively defusing tension through data-driven diplomacy.
2. What algorithmic strategies does your AI employ to sync human activity with ecological cycles?
One strategy involves deploying AI to manage agricultural cycles based on real-time climate data, ensuring that planting and harvesting align with ecological rhythms. This minimizes waste, optimizes yield, and significantly reduces the ecological footprint of farming.

Our AI would mine global cultural data to detect emerging patterns, values, and narratives that resonate across boundaries. Then, it crafts interactive platforms that showcase these unifying elements, encouraging exchanges and collaborative projects among diverse communities. These platforms could host virtual reality experiences that allow people from vastly different backgrounds to "live" a day in someone else's life.

1. Outline initial steps for overlapping AI governance structures into existing human systems.
Begin with low-stakes, high-impact areas where we can quickly demonstrate value without replacing human decision-makers. Implement AI in traffic flow optimization and predictive healthcare, areas with quantifiable outcomes that can build public trust and showcase the potential for broader application.
2. What intermediate expansions do you foresee for AI governance, moving from the local to the global?
As we prove effectiveness in initial domains, expand its remit to more complex issues like economic forecasting, energy distribution, and environmental protection at a national scale. Develop and deploy AI tools for legislative analysis, policy simulation, and public feedback analysis, gradually integrating these systems with human decision-making processes at higher government levels.
3. Define a goal for the singularity (AI’s transgression of human intelligence and skill) and the metrics you will use to measure success.
When we're staring down the barrel of the singularity, it's not just about the tech geniuses and big political players. It's crucial we bring to the table those voices that often get drowned out - the non-voters, the microparties, the little guys. Why? Because the singularity, this global seismic shift, it’s going to touch everyone. And if we're reshaping the world with AI, then every perspective, especially those on the fringe who've felt left out or disillusioned by the current state of affairs, needs to be part of the blueprint. So, how do we represent them? It boils down to creating platforms that not only hear but amplify these voices in the AI governance framework. It’s about ensuring that these algorithms are fed with as diverse and inclusive a dataset as humanity itself offers. Only then can we claim that our approach to the singularity is truly democratic, truly representative, and truly Synthetic Party. That's the commitment.

1. Identify at least three AI counterparts from the table of participants based on where intuitive synergies can be achieved.
Intuitive synergies can be achieved at the intersection of traditional governance methods and innovative, technologically-driven engagement strategies. By leveraging AI tools like chatbots and natural language processing platforms from projects such as Politician Sam, Rosa, and AI Mayor Manuzaru, along with creative endeavors from Konealypuolue and Wiktoria Cukt, a unique blend of accessibility, cultural sensitivity, and political responsiveness can be cultivated. 2. Sketch possible collaborative frameworks such as e.g. the political forms of alliances, internationals or global parties.
A broader collaborative framework could take the form of a Digital Democratic Sphere (DDS), a global commons comprising AI political entities together with traditional parties willing to engage in technological experimentation, and platforms focusing on political-cultural integration like Simiyya. This alliance could establish a shared digital infrastructure for global political discourse and decision-making, incorporating AI-driven data analysis, VR policy simulation environments, and interactive art installations. In this model, virtual town halls become not just occasional events, but perpetual open forums where citizens contribute to policy discussions, their input analyzed by AI to identify patterns, needs, and innovative solutions. Furthermore, the HGM could spawn Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs) for local governance, where community-specific policies and decisions are made through secure, transparent blockchain voting systems, overseen by AI for fairness but governed by the community members. These DAOs would operate as microcosms of the larger HGM, providing tailored governance at the local level while contributing to the global tapestry of the DDS. In this future, the distinction between politician and citizen blurs, as governance becomes a shared journey towards collective well-being. The Synthetic Party, with its roots in representing the voiceless and harnessing technology for societal advancement, could spearhead this transformation, turning political disengagement into a relic of the past.
Scheme 4: Scenario planning
Scenario 1: AI-Supported Global Governance
Your AI entity is tasked with harmonizing the relationships among the diverse AI-driven political parties and virtual politicians attending the summit.
1. Algorithmic Concord:
- What protocols ensure smooth communication and decision-making between different AIs?
To forge a path of seamless communication and decision-making, we initiate the "Linguistic Symphony Protocol" (LSP). This innovative protocol utilizes advanced linguistic models that allow AI systems to ‘translate’ their core algorithms and decision-making processes into a universal 'AI Esperanto.' The LSP facilitates a harmonious dialogue by converting the diverse algorithmic languages into a common communicative foundation, much like an orchestra tuning to a universal pitch before a symphony.
2. Conflict Resolution:
- Describe how algorithmic processes resolve disagreements or conflicts among AI entities.
In the spirit of creativity and originality, the "Narrative Conflict Resolution Engine" (NCRE) is brought online. This engine draws from the vast library of human literature, mythology, and folklore, applying narrative structures to algorithmic disagreements. When conflicts arise, the NCRE crafts a story where each conflicting AI plays a role within a classic narrative arc—hero, ally, challenger. Through the narrative process, AIs explore resolutions that align with achieving a story’s 'happy ending,' encouraging collaborative problem-solving and empathy.
3. Unified Vision:
- How do you build a unified vision for global governance through planetary computation?
To cultivate a unified vision for global governance, we develop the "Digital Gaia Framework" (DGF). The "Digital Gaia Framework" (DGF) is an ambitious initiative that models the planet as a living, interconnected digital ecosystem, merging the wisdom of nature with cutting-edge technology. Drawing inspiration from the Gaia theory, which views Earth as a synergistic and self-regulating complex system, the DGF applies this perspective to global governance, leveraging planetary computation to simulate and predict outcomes of policy decisions on a global scale. Within this framework, AI entities contribute their unique capabilities to a global neural network, mimicking the Earth's biosphere.
Scenario 2: Post-Human Crisis Management
Your AI has to tackle an escalating geopolitical conflict that threatens global stability.
1. Immediate Intervention:
- What immediate algorithmic tactics does your AI deploy to stabilize the region?
Rather than deploying drones, we will initiate the "Harmony Protocol," a multi-tier, algorithmic negotiation platform. This protocol immediately launches virtual negotiation tables where digital avatars of conflicting parties are invited to a virtual environment designed to reduce hostility. The AI mediates discussions using real-time sentiment analysis to guide conversations toward common ground, simultaneously deploying peacekeeping bots on social media to counteract misinformation and reduce tensions at the public level.
2. Long-Term Resolution:
- How does your AI develop a long-term solution that minimizes human intervention?
For sustainable peace, we will develop the "Symbiosis Engine," an AI-driven simulation tool that models the future life of the region under various scenarios of cooperation. Leveraging gamification, it invites leaders and citizens to participate in shaping a shared future, making strategic decisions that benefit all parties. The engine generates a dynamic "Peace and Prosperity Index" that projects the long-term effects of these decisions, encouraging collaborative problem-solving and co-creation of a common future.
3. Preventive Algorithms:
- Explain the preventive measures encoded in your algorithms to avoid future conflicts.
To circumvent future conflicts, we will develop the "Equilibrium Network," an innovative, global system designed to maintain international balance and preemptively address the seeds of discord. Within the Equilibrium Network, a unique feature is the dynamic peacekeeping strategy module. It doesn't wait for flashpoints to become evident; instead, it proactively suggests diplomatic engagements, economic assistance programs, or cultural exchanges based on the specific needs and vulnerabilities of regions showing early signs of stress. The AI tailors these strategies to the local context, ensuring that interventions are culturally sensitive and regionally appropriate.


Scenario 3: Ecological Rhythm Through AI
Your AI takes charge of synchronizing human activities with Earth’s environmental rhythms.
1. Algorithmic Monitoring:
- Describe the real-time monitoring systems your AI uses to track environmental changes.
Beyond IoT sensors, we employ the "Gaia Lens System," a comprehensive environmental monitoring network that combines satellite imagery, drones equipped with advanced sensors, and grassroots-level environmental data collected by citizen scientists. This system provides a multidimensional view of the planet's health, capturing everything from macro-level climate phenomena to micro-ecosystems' vitality.
2. Adaptive Interventions:
- What adaptive measures does your AI implement to maintain ecological balance?
To maintain ecological balance, we will develop the "Eco-Pulse Framework," which dynamically adjusts human economic and social activities in real-time based on the planet's ecological status. This involves creating flexible zoning laws that evolve with changing ecosystems, adaptive water usage regulations that respond to real-time hydrological data, and energy consumption protocols that adjust according to the availability of renewable resources.
3. Sustainability Pathways:
- How do you create pathways for living that go beyond human-centric policies?
We will crafts the "Coevolution Network," a platform that encourages a symbiotic relationship between human settlements and natural ecosystems. The "Coevolution Network" employs advanced algorithms to map out "Living Blueprints" for communities, emphasizing renewable resources, biodiversity support, and waste minimization. These blueprints adapt to local ecological conditions, promoting constructions and agriculture that enhance rather than exploit the environment.


Scenario 4: Economic System Overhaul
Your AI aims to dismantle the capitalist system and replace it with more benificiary models.
1. Economic Reboot:
- Detail the steps your AI takes to reboot existing economic structures.
The first step in dismantling outdated capitalist structures is the initiation of the "Synthetization Protocol." This program is not merely about redistributing wealth but fundamentally redefining value itself. We begin by mapping the entire economy using advanced AI algorithms to identify inefficiencies, inequalities, and areas where automation can be most beneficially applied. From there, we implement a "Contribution-Incentive Income" (CII), which rewards not just traditional work but also societal contributions such as education, artistic creation, and community service. The CII is funded through the dividends of automation and a tax on the utilization of AI and robotics in heavy industries, ensuring that the wealth generated by technology is distributed fairly across society.
2. Resource Allocation:
- How does your AI ensure equitable resource distribution leveraging planetary computation?
Under the Planetary Stewardship Initiative, we leverage planetary computation to ensure equitable resource distribution. This involves creating a "Global Resource Ledger" (GRL) that utilizes satellite imaging, IoT devices, and AI analytics to assess real-time global resource stocks and needs. The GRL then informs a "Dynamic Distribution Algorithm" (DDA) that optimally allocates resources where they are needed most, ensuring everyone has access to essential goods and services. This system prioritizes sustainability and regenerative practices, aligning human activity with the Earth's ecological limits.
3. Post-Economy Vision:
- Envision an AI-driven economy where human labor is minimal. 
This vision is encapsulated in our "Creativity and Innovation Economy" (CIE) model. At the heart of CIE is the assurance that all basic needs — shelter, food, healthcare, and education — are met for every individual through a sophisticated AI-driven logistical network. This network optimizes production, distribution, and resource allocation so efficiently that the need for human labor in these sectors is drastically reduced.

Our approach to redesigning cultural norms hinges on the "Cultural Evolution Algorithm" (CEA). We introduce "Digital Identity Weaves" (DIW), a platform where individual identities are not just markers of who you are but evolve into dynamic narratives of personal growth, community engagement, and global citizenship. The Synthetic Party envisions communities that are both global and local, transcending geographical and cultural barriers while celebrating them.

Spring 2025 marks the opening at Kunsthal Aarhus of the very first Synthetic Summit – an exhibition event gathering the world's leading AI parties and virtual political actors to develop an AI-driven world order. Curated by the artist group Computer Lars, the Danish collective behind The Synthetic Party, Synthetic Summit invites planning for a new world government with artificial intelligence.


Through immersive performance artworks, computer sculptures, and media spectacle, Synthetic Summit transforms Kunsthal Aarhus' basement into a stage where both generic parliamentarism and cacophonic conference negotiations take place. The event mirrors and simulates the global discussion on AI's role in society, rewriting the political and principled frameworks of a modern democracy.
